parameter.name: ipAddress
parameter.label: IP Address
parameter.description: IP Address of the device.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device Id
parameter.description: The id of the device.

parameter.name: transitionPeriod
parameter.label: Transition Period
parameter.description: Time the transition to the new state takes in milliseconds.

parameter.name: refresh
parameter.label: Refresh Rate
parameter.description: Refresh of device state in seconds.

parameter.name: protocol
parameter.label: Local Protocol
parameter.description: Transport used by the device. AUTO probes legacy XOR first and then authenticated KLAP.

parameter.name: username
parameter.label: TP-Link Account
parameter.description: TP-Link/Kasa account e-mail. Required by devices that enforce authenticated local access.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: TP-Link Password
parameter.description: Password for the TP-Link/Kasa account. It is used only for local device authentication.

parameter.name: httpPort
parameter.label: KLAP HTTP Port
parameter.description: HTTP port used by KLAP. Modern discovery normally supplies this automatically.
